news.title: Got Anthropic shares at $83? When ANT stock will reach your brokerage account and the broker rule that could cost you future IPOs
news.description: Anthropic IPO price (ANT stock): Anthropic made its Nasdaq debut under the ticker ANT at $83 a share, putting its market value at about $1.10 trillion. The $81.34 billion IPO is the largest on record. Pre-trading perpetual futures pointed to $104, but those contracts were not actual shares. IPO allocations are scheduled to settle November 20. Investors selling within 30 days should check their broker's rules, which may restrict access to future IPOs.
